correctness.rationale: For the exact copying rule the four displayed count rates follow by tallying sources and recipients. All free-zero is reachable from every configuration using the right zealot and then a free left zero. The only configuration not reachable in reverse is all free left ones and all free right zeros; it has no entrance and has an exit. In the other configurations a temporary free right one supplied by the left zealot permits construction of all requested left ones, and when the target has no free right ones a free left zero removes the temporary one. This yields a unique stationary law. Applying stationarity to individual indicators gives x=(b−1)/(N−1), y=b/(N−1), where N=a+b. From the product equations, substitution of the same-side expressions U=(b−1)V/b and W=y/a+(a−1)V/a into the cross-side equation gives (3N−4)V=b(a+3b−4)/(N−1). Any absent same-side product has zero coefficient both in that equation and in the variance sum. The diagonal contribution to Var(1+I+J) is (a−1)(b−1)N/(N−1)^2; the ordered-pair contribution is (a−1)(b−1)N(N−2)^2/[(N−1)^2(3N−4)]. Their sum divided by N² is the claimed variance. For the limit, let p=(I+1)/a, q=J/b, z=(p+q)/2 and d=p−q. Stationarity of d², Ld=−2d+(1−q)/a+p/b, and Γ(d,d)≤1/a+1/b imply E[d²]=O(1/N) for interior proportions. Directly the exact squared jump rate of z is Γ(z,z)=(p+q−2pq)(1/a+1/b)/4−(1−q)/(4a²)−p/(4b²). Thus NΓ converges in mean to z(1−z)/(2αβ) in the sense of vanishing mean absolute difference. With the exact drift this gives the stated limiting polynomial generator; the total cubic error after multiplying by N is O(1/N). Compactness and the stationary moment recurrence determine every weak limit as Beta(2β,2α); F−z tends to zero in probability. These algebraic checks replay the finite and infinite claims, including a=2 or b=2 in the finite formulas, and do not extend to the excluded aspect-ratio endpoints. The supplied checker and verification notes were read, not executed.
